title: Witness to the Void
method: htdemucs vocal stem -> torchaudio MMS_FA forced alignment, each line inside its hand-stamped window, checked by a pass with each line's neighbours in a wider window
notes: start/end: aligned onset/offset (line start falls back to hand_start when its words do not agree between the two passes). hand_start: the hand-stamped LRC time. dev = start - hand_start. score/confidence: mean CTC posterior (0..1); sung vowels score low even when placed right. agree: the anchored and the context pass put the word start within 0.35 s; rating comes from the share of agreeing words.

lines.text: You haven't spoken since Tuesday began
You're barely a ghost, let alone a man
The dinner I made is cold on the plate
You whisper to servers across the abyss
Ignoring the warmth of a physical kiss
While the real world dissolves and disappears
You think you are building a kingdom of code?
You're just wasting away in this humble abode
You smile at the monitor, a lover's embrace
But the pixels don't care about your unshaven face
The "Beast" that you fear? It isn't the Baud
It's the silence behind you, ignoring your god
The "Beauty" you seek in the render's design?
Wipe the sweat from your brow!
While the real world dissolves and disappears
You think you are building a kingdom of code?
You're just wasting away in this humble abode
